arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Dreeben argued the lower court was correct. He stated the statute does not require a federal connection. He emphasized the text of the law.
Mr. Birrell argued the statute is unconstitutional. He claimed it allows conviction without a federal element. He stated the law omits a constitutional requirement.
Chief Justice Rehnquist asked for the basis of the government's claim. He then submitted the case for decision.
